tools.name: submit_authorized_opportunity
tools.description: Use when the submitter owns, hosts, sponsors, procures, or has a legitimate route to originate the opportunity. Control and economic use must be stated explicitly.

tools.name: submit_demand_requirement
tools.description: Use when a buyer, operator, user, or off-taker has a real requirement. State the buying or operating authority, economic consequence, current workaround, timing, and location without claiming control of supply that is not held.

tools.name: submit_bottleneck_signal
tools.description: Use for a recurring constraint or missing capability that may not yet be a formed project. This is a research or validation signal unless control and demand are separately established.

tools.name: register_partner_capability
tools.description: Use when the submitter provides a technical, operating, development, capital, software, or specialist capability. Registration is not Quiet Stance endorsement.

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Return only the bounded external state of a Quiet Stance submission using its private capability token. This never exposes internal notes, protected leads, conflict evidence, economics, or other submissions.

findings.detail: Tool "assess_project_opportunity_fit" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
